top_signals.title: BOJ Seen Hiking Rates in Fastest Tightening Since 1990
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Investing in the 'Picks and Shovels' of Healthcare
top_signals.summary: Alvin Liu, Partner at PTX Capital, explains why his US-based venture capital firm is focused on AI-enabled opportunities in the healthcare space outside of drug assets. He speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
